subject: general
question: Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively and are fixed in their positions. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. CADB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph begins with the protagonist hearing footsteps in the corridor (S1).
 
• Sentence C logically follows, as it describes the door opening and the appearance of Count Scarlet, which builds suspense.
 
• Sentence A then introduces a detailed description of Count Scarlet, emphasizing his physical traits (tall, lanky, freckled, etc.).
 
• Sentence D continues the physical description, focusing on his large hands.
 
• Sentence B concludes the description, highlighting his knees and tightly fitting trousers.
 
• The paragraph ends with S2, where Count Scarlet lifts his hand and speaks, adding dramatic flair.

Correct sequence: *S1 → C → A → D → B → S2*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coherence:** The sequence ensures logical progression from the event (hearing footsteps) to the description of Count Scarlet and his actions.
 
• **Unity:** All sentences are interconnected and contribute to the overall narrative of the paragraph.
